steps.name: 01 Settings
steps.goal: Open Settings: tap the Navigation button, then tap Settings in the side menu.
steps.done: The Settings screen shows the Computer section and a Control Computer row.

steps.name: 02 Open the Computer, view only
steps.goal: Tap Control Computer and wait for the Computer screen to open. Do not tap anything on it.
steps.done: The Computer screen shows the live desktop with a floating control pill that offers Take control. Nothing on it asks you to compose or send a message.

steps.name: 03 Take control
steps.goal: Tap Take control on the floating pill.
steps.done: The pill reads Controlling and explains the trackpad gesture.
expect: Drag to move the pointer. Tap to click.

steps.name: 04 Open the keyboard over the screen
steps.goal: Tap Show keyboard on the floating pill.
steps.done: The iOS keyboard is open, a key row above it offers esc, tab, ctrl and arrows, and the live screen is still visible above the pill.

steps.name: 05 Type straight onto the desktop
steps.goal: Type into the Computer. The keyboard is already open and the field already has focus.
steps.done: The keys went to the Computer. The keyboard is still open, nothing was drafted on screen, and there is no Send button.

steps.name: 06 Put the keyboard away, keep control
steps.done: The keyboard and its key row are gone, the whole desktop is visible again, and the pill still reads Controlling.
